content: CMMS/maintenance-system rollouts fail primarily on adoption (~70% of failures), not technology: users excluded from tool selection, insufficient training, weak leadership sponsorship, and poor data quality (a CMMS is only as good as the data entered -- incomplete/inconsistent building or asset codes break downstream analytics). Relevant to this project: technician and triage-officer buy-in, and having a clean, complete building/asset code reference table before go-live, matter as much as the AI accuracy work.
